admission.justification: The keepalive obligation needs both the rail shell wrapper and the frame descriptor latch; neither file alone promises the retained element. Typed per-case proofs were withdrawn as extractor-unsupported; case evidence lives at file granularity in the cards.

applicability: The shell's right-rail document chat for the dashboard-open lifetime after its frame has been created, including the review page's chat column.
conditions: Operations keeps first-show creation when no preload was requested; a review requests preload while its chat column is closed.
A cold review preload loads the Paseo client without an agent address or agent start; showing the column asks for its bound existing task chat through ar.open when the channel is ready.
The review is a grid slot beside the same right rail, and neither the DocumentChat nor its iframe is moved to another parent.
River/chat and sidebar visibility changes hide the retained wrapper; ordinary page transitions and ready-channel task changes retain the same frame generation.
The hidden wrapper remains out of keyboard and accessibility reach.
exclusions: A host application or version change.
Explicit Retry, host-return or qualified unavailable-channel recovery loads, which keep their existing separate rules.
Any new agent menu or creation of an agent on page/column open.

evidence: dashboard/src/cockpit/sidebarChatStaysLoaded.test.tsx (toggle keeps element; switch keeps element; ghost keeps element) + e2e/sidebar-chat-stays-loaded.spec.ts (walk, execution owed on Owner path)

statement: The shell keeps one DocumentChat and its frame mounted across Operations, task documents and the review page, hiding it without unloading so draft and scroll survive visibility toggles.
